Headline: #8 Halsted Temporary Reroute at Halsted/71st
ShortDescription: #8 Halsted buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near Halsted/71st.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#8 Halsted buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Halsted, 74th, Racine, 69th, and Halsted then over their regular route due to, street blockage near Halsted/71st.

Allow extra travel time.
